metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure finance-composition from .claude/orrery/plan.json. Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. title: "Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror" subtitle: Page hooks call pure lib/finance modules; metricRules.ts and metric_rules.py hold the same matchers, kept in step by hand direction: down layout: { spacing: 0.6 } legend: dotted: same rules kept in step by hand (no traffic) story: [h-health, f-rules, b-rules, b-analytics] groups: consumers: type: zone label: Page hooks and views evidence: frontend/src/pages libfin: type: zone label: frontend/src/lib/finance evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/metricRules.ts be-rules: type: zone label: backend core evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py nodes: # Page hooks, in the order their arrows enter lib/finance. h-income: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useIncomeAnalysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/income-analysis/useIncomeAnalysis.ts:23" } # Reads Age of Money, Days of Buffering, the transfer split and the health inputs from the backend # (GET /api/dashboard-metrics/pulse and /health); demo mode answers them with the browser calculators. h-dash: icon: tabler:app-window label: useDashboardMetrics note: demo mode runs the browser calculators in: consumers evidence: - "frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts:22" - "frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts:37" - "frontend/src/lib/demo/demoDashboardMetrics.ts:47" h-tax: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useTaxPlanning, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:27" } h-nw: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useNetWorth, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:5-12" } h-health: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: Health score analysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/components/analytics/health/healthScoreAnalysis.ts:10-11" } h-goals: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useGoalsState, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/goals/useGoalsState.ts:7" } h-spend: { icon: tabler:app-window, label: useSpendingAnalysis, in: consumers, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/spending-analysis/useSpendingAnalysis.ts:30" } # One node for two hooks that call the same module. h-returns: icon: tabler:app-window label: Returns, investments note: two hooks in: consumers evidence: - "frontend/src/pages/returns-analysis/useReturnsAnalysis.ts:18" - "frontend/src/pages/investment-analytics/useInvestmentAnalytics.ts:15" # lib/finance modules. f-dash: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: dashboardMetrics, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/dashboardMetrics.ts } f-flows: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: investmentFlows, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/investmentFlows.ts:1" } f-taxhist: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: taxHistory, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/taxHistory.ts:5" } f-tax: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: taxPlanning, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/taxPlanning.ts } f-nw: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: netWorth, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/netWorth.ts } f-avg: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: monthlyAverage, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/monthlyAverage.ts:41-86" } f-rules: { icon: tabler:scale, label: metricRules.ts, in: libfin, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/finance/metricRules.ts:26-88" } f-spend: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: spending, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/spending.ts } f-income: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: incomeMetrics, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/incomeMetrics.ts } f-returns: { icon: tabler:math-function, label: investmentReturns, in: libfin, evidence: frontend/src/lib/finance/investmentReturns.ts } # Backend twin and its consumers: the Dashboard metrics ports of the browser calculators, and the analytics engine. b-dash: icon: tabler:gauge label: Dashboard metrics note: pulse and health reads in: be-rules align: b-rules evidence: - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics.py:150#dashboard_pulse" - "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/dashboard_metrics.py:171#dashboard_health" b-rules: { icon: tabler:scale, label: metric_rules.py, in: be-rules, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/core/metric_rules.py:66-284" } b-analytics: icon: tabler:chart-bar label: Analytics engine in: be-rules evidence: - { from: h-returns, to: f-returns, label: calls, evidence: "frontend/src/pages/returns-analysis/useReturnsAnalysis.ts:18#investmentReturnRules" } - from: h-returns to: f-flows label: calls evidence: - svg.title: Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror
svg.desc: Shared finance rules: lib/finance and its backend mirror. 21 components in 3 groups. Connections: useDashboardMetrics to dashboardMetrics (calls); useDashboardMetrics to backend core (GET pulse, health); useTaxPlanning to taxHistory (calls); useTaxPlanning to taxPlanning (calls); useNetWorth to netWorth (calls); useNetWorth to monthlyAverage (calls); useGoalsState to monthlyAverage (calls); Health score analysis to monthlyAverage (month spine); Health score analysis to metricRules.ts (essentials); useSpendingAnalysis to spending (calls); spending to monthlyAverage (month spine); useIncomeAnalysis to incomeMetrics (calls); Returns, investments to investmentReturns (calls); Returns, investments to investmentFlows (calls); investmentFlows to metricRules.ts (phrasePattern); taxHistory to metricRules.ts (salary vs bonus); metricRules.ts to metric_rules.py (mirrors); metric_rules.py to Dashboard metrics (classify); metric_rules.py to Analytics engine (classify).

text.tspan: SHARED FINANCE RULES: LIB/FINANCE AND ITS BACKEND MIRROR
Page hooks call pure lib/finance modules; metricRules.ts and metric_rules.py hold the same matchers, kept in step by hand
SAME RULES KEPT IN STEP BY HAND (NO TRAFFIC)
